syncColors.label: Sync colours with the Omarchy theme
syncColors.description: Tabby uses the current Omarchy theme palette and follows every theme change. Picking another scheme in Tabby pauses the sync until you re-apply it.

syncFont.label: Sync font with Omarchy
syncFont.description: Tabby uses the font chosen with `omarchy font set`. The font size is left alone.

clipboardKeys.label: Omarchy universal clipboard
clipboardKeys.description: SUPER+C / SUPER+V copy and paste in Tabby, like in the other Omarchy terminals.

smartCwd.label: New terminals follow Tabby's directory
smartCwd.description: When Tabby is focused, a new terminal (SUPER+RETURN) opens in the directory of the active tab.

tuiTerminal.label: Terminal for Omarchy TUIs
tuiTerminal.description: Omarchy apps that need their own window (floating installers, btop, impala…) open here. 'auto' picks the first installed of foot, alacritty, ghostty, kitty; 'tabby' keeps everything in Tabby.

focusOnOpen.label: Focus Tabby when a tab opens
focusOnOpen.description: Bring the Tabby window to the front after opening a tab from Omarchy.
